game.title: Basic Game
scenes.standard.title: Standard view
scenes.standard.components.narrative.tex:
Morning light falls through the museum’s high windows. Beyond the entrance hall, voices drift between the marble pillars.

A curator waits beside a display of old maps. She looks up from her notes as you approach.

“Look for the blue seal,” she says, nodding toward the table. “It bears the same crest as the display case in the east gallery.”

A door between the pillars leads east. The street outside runs down to the old harbour.
